intent: Nabhi Labs public marketing website that explains the product and collects conversation inquiries via mailto.

goals.primaryUsers: Prospective customers and partners evaluating Nabhi Labs
goals.successMetric: Qualified conversation requests started from the Begin form

decisions.choice: Next.js App Router with static marketing sections
decisions.rationale: The product needs a public brochure site, and the repo already ships as a Next.js App Router app with no backend APIs.

decisions.choice: Mailto inquiry form instead of a server mailbox API
decisions.rationale: BeginSection opens a mailto to hello@nabhilabs.com, so inquiry capture does not require a datastore write path yet.
All routes are public marketing content with no member or admin surfaces in the codebase.

decisions.choice: No dedicated database or queue workers
decisions.rationale: Package dependencies and app routes show only page rendering and static assets, with no ORM, queue, or worker packages present.
